node.title: Mersenne linear-factor projective-star router
node.closure: a linear interpolation factor is forced to be an F-rational projective star
node.statement: At Mersenne full-lift support e=130237, suppose the full common interpolation factor has Y,Z degree one. Write its primitive form as A(X)Y+B(X)Z+C(X). The at least 4982 captured degree-five polynomial pairs force gcd(A,B)=1 and deg A,deg B<=5. They parameterize by a polynomial t of degree at most s=5-max(deg A,deg B). If max(deg A,deg B)>=1, ordinary Johnson at agreement 807 caps the t-list by 802, contradiction. Hence A and B are constants. The factor and its captured affine explanation lines are F-rational and share one projective slope-codeword center: finite when A is nonzero, at infinity when A=0. Thus the first-support MCA residual splits into a projective-star population problem and factors of Y,Z degree at least two.
